alpha_rescue_text: I adopted Alpha from a shelter when she was only 3 months old. She was very sick — she had IV drips because she was poisoned. Despite the difficulties, she managed to overcome the illness and become a real fighter. We've been inseparable ever since. ❤️
alpha_best_friend_text: Alpha has a best friend — Graf. They always play together and are inseparable. Here they are in the photo — a real gang!
alpha_hobby_text_start: My dog Alpha is not just a friend, but a personal IT disposal specialist. Her hobby is collecting wires from my MacBook. Already five pieces in her 'portfolio'!
